description: NL->CAD tasks. `prompt` is all the agent sees; `hidden` is the grader's spec, checked on the agent's exported STEP in a fresh sandboxed FreeCAD process. Bounding boxes are compared orientation-free (sorted extents); holes are matched by diameter on any axis.

tasks.prompt: Design a 120 x 80 x 10 mm aluminium mounting plate with four M6 clearance holes (ISO 273 medium fit), each 12 mm from the two nearest edges. Export FCStd and STEP.
Model a round flange: outer diameter 100 mm, thickness 8 mm, central bore 30 mm, and six 9 mm bolt holes equally spaced on a 75 mm pitch circle. Export STEP.
Make an L-shaped angle bracket: both legs 40 mm long measured on the outside, 5 mm thick, 30 mm wide, with no fillets. Export STEP.
Create a stepped shaft: a 20 mm diameter section 30 mm long followed coaxially by a 12 mm diameter section 40 mm long. No chamfers. Export STEP.
Make a flat washer with outer diameter 24 mm, inner diameter 13 mm and thickness 3 mm. Export STEP.
Model an open-top rectangular tray: outside 60 x 40 x 30 mm, 5 mm walls, 5 mm floor, sharp corners. Export STEP.

Model a cylindrical hub 40 mm in diameter and 20 mm tall with a 10 mm through bore on its axis, plus four flat-bottomed M8 tap-drill holes, 15 mm deep, drilled into the top face on a 28 mm pitch circle. Export STEP.
Make a hexagonal standoff 10 mm across flats and 20 mm long, with a through hole sized as the tap drill for M5 along its axis. Export STEP.
